name: Banishing Smite

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

casting_time.trigger: Taken immediately after you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

summary: Your hit deals an extra 5d10 Force; a target left at 50 Hit Points or fewer may be sent to a demiplane.
text: If the hit leaves the target at 50 Hit Points or fewer, it makes a Charisma save or is shunted to a harmless demiplane, Incapacitated, until the spell ends; then it returns to the space it left or the nearest free one.
